tell.label: “Luftwaffen-Eigentum” Leica
tell.alt: The same camera body with added military engraving

verdict: The serial says 1952; the engraving claims 1943. The eye that catches that is the one you want before you wire.
provenance: Leitz kept factory shipping ledgers: the serial number dates the body to a 1952 civilian batch — years after the 'wartime' issue the engraving claims. The militaria was added to a common postwar body to multiply the price.
